An '''audio-link''' was an audio receiver in [[Speeder truck/Legends|speeder trucks]] such as the [[A-A2 Speeder Truck]]. It could pick up various channels broadcasting [[Music/Legends|music]].<ref name="HL">{{WEGCite|story=Heavy Lifting|book=Instant Adventures}}</ref>
